title.zh: 所得税（外国收入豁免）（第 7 号）命令 2017
title.en: Income Tax (Exemption of Foreign Income) (No. 7) Order 2017

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Income Tax (Exemption of Foreign Income) (No. 7) Order 2017.

2.—(1) Dividends received by Interflour Group Pte Ltd (a company incorporated in Singapore) from Interflour Holdings (Malaysia) Sdn Bhd (a company incorporated in Malaysia) on or after 11 June 2014, and derived from dividends received by Interflour Holdings (Malaysia) Sdn Bhd from Sabah Flour & Feed Mills Sdn Bhd (a company incorporated in Malaysia), are exempt from tax.
(2) The exemption in sub-paragraph (1) is subject to the conditions specified in paragraph 5 of the letter of approval dated 6 June 2017 addressed to Ernst & Young Solutions LLP.
